review_findings.label: lem:forward-dini-comparison-with-downward-jumps
review_findings.finding: The downward-jump condition is imposed only for 1 <= j < N, and continuity is imposed only on half-open partition intervals. Nothing controls f(b), although the conclusion includes b.
review_findings.counterexample: Take a=0, b=1, N=1, psi=0, G=0, f(t)=0 for 0<=t<1 and f(1)=1. Every written hypothesis holds but f(1)<=G(1) fails.
review_findings.required_change: Require the finite left lower limit and downward endpoint inequality also at j=N, or supply a sufficient terminal continuity condition.

review_findings.label: thm:finite-time-extinction
review_findings.finding: OpenGA currently proves a continuous comparison for -4*pi + 3*W/(4*(t+C)). This blueprint uses loop-family width with -2*pi + 3*W/(1+4*t), nonzero starting times and downward jumps at surgery.
review_findings.required_change: Build and verify the normalization or generalized coefficient/time-shift bridge and a finite-partition comparison. Do not equate this calculus endpoint with finite-time extinction of a surgery flow.

review_findings.label: thm:poincare-conjecture
review_findings.finding: The reference root assumes a smooth closed 3-manifold and concludes a diffeomorphism. The existing platform root assumes a compact Hausdorff topological 3-manifold with ChartedSpace and concludes a homeomorphism.
review_findings.required_change: Supply a compatible smoothing result and forget the smooth structure at the conclusion before linking the smooth route to the existing target. The reference root is not a signature-identical replacement.

review_findings.finding: All 61 important nodes are marked notready and have no Lean mapping in the primary blueprint at this commit. Some supporting source projects contain Lean proofs; evaluate those separately.

The primary blueprint reorganizes, strengthens and combines source results. Source cross-references identify where to review; they are not captain attestation. Milestone titles must use verified original source indices and statements.
The curve-shrinking chapter cites the Morgan-Tian correction. Keep the corrected constants and hypotheses when selecting Chapter 19 targets.
